name: The Hostage Heir
about: A great house's heir has grown up at your court as your ward. Their lord wants the child back, the child has ideas of their own, and a rival house would like the boy dead.
title: The Ward of {lord.house}

beats.speaker: lord
beats.text: {ward} has grown up at Kingsmere as the crown's ward. Now {lord} writes for the first time in years, because {lord.he} wants {lord.his} heir home.

court.text: {lord} of {lord.house}: "My heir has been your guest long enough, Your Grace. Send {ward} home, and {lord.house} will know you trust us."

options.label: Send {ward} home with honours
options.hint: {lord.houseName} +20 · you lose your hold on them
options.result: {ward} rides home to {seat} with a royal escort and the King's blessing.

options.label: Keep {ward} at Kingsmere
options.result: The King keeps {ward} at court. In {seat}, {lord} stops writing.

options.label: Keep {ward} and marry {ward.him} to your pick
options.hint: {lord.houseName} −5 · {ward} is tied to Kingsmere for good
options.result: {ward} is betrothed at court. {lord} sends a cold gift for the wedding.

beats.speaker: ward
beats.text: {ward} is home at {seat} and speaks warmly of the King. {rival} hears about it and isn't pleased.

beats.speaker: lord
beats.text: {lord.house}'s men try to sneak {ward} out of Kingsmere at night. They're caught at the river gate, with {ward}.

court.text: {rival} of {rival.house}: "{lord.house} tried to steal its heir out from under your roof, Your Grace. If you let that go, every ward in the realm will try it."

options.label: Send the men home and keep the child
options.result: The men go home with a message. The King understands a father's heart, but he's keeping the child.

options.label: Hang the men at the river gate
options.result: Five of {lord.house}'s men hang at the river gate. {ward} watches from a window.

options.label: Let the child go home
options.hint: {lord.houseName} +15 · the realm sees you back down
options.result: The King lets {ward} go. {rival} calls it weakness in every hall that will listen.

beats.speaker: rival
beats.text: Someone leaves a knife in {ward}'s bed, and a servant of {rival.house} has vanished. Maybe it was meant to kill and maybe it was a warning, but {lord} knows who to blame.

court.text: {lord}: "{rival} sent a knife for my child, Your Grace. Give me justice, or I'll take it myself."

options.label: Fine {rival.house} and guard the heir yourself (150 gold)
options.result: {rival.house} pays a blood fine, and {ward} sleeps behind the King's own guard.

options.label: Say there's no proof
options.result: The King finds no proof. {lord} has all the proof {lord} needs.

beats.speaker: lord
beats.text: {lord.house} marches on {rival.house} over the knife. The realm burns from {seat} to {rival.seat}.

beats.speaker: lord
beats.text: The crown hanged {lord}'s men and kept {lord.his} child, so {lord} raises {lord.his} banners and marches on Kingsmere to take {ward} back by force.

beats.speaker: ward
beats.text: {ward} grows up loyal to the crown that raised {ward.him}, and {lord.house} comes with {ward.him}. {thread} ends with a house that owes you and means to pay it back.

memory.ward: The King raised me and kept me safe. My house owes the crown.

beats.speaker: ward
beats.text: {lord}'s army breaks at Kingsmere. {ward} watched it from the walls, and will rule {seat} one day knowing what the crown can do.

beats.speaker: lord
beats.text: {ward} dies young, and with {ward.him} goes the crown's hold on {lord.house}. {lord} won't forgive it.

beats.speaker: ward
beats.text: {lord} dies, and {ward} rides home from Kingsmere to rule {seat}, a lord raised by the crown.
